scope: 2025 ICPC Nanjing A B C E F G H I J K M
limitations: Independent checks of explanations; no online submissions, extreme-scale timing, optimized E deque or NTT implementation verification. A covers every valid hidden board state.

A.method: every allowed board size and hole position; exact moving-bitboard simulation and query bound

B.method: integer-direction enumeration versus grouped angular sweep, including zeros and opposite rays

E.method: threshold DP and both color passes versus enumeration of every simple path; excludes optimized deque

F.method: incremental subset DSUs versus exhaustive vertex-and-mask reachability

G.method: all set partitions of buckets versus extreme-pair deletion

H.method: all binary strings through length 9 against literal four-substring enumeration, plus published long example

I.method: full history policy-tree enumeration versus four-state backward DP, including zero probability

J.method: enumerate roots and neighbor orders for small connected graphs; compare with true cuts and brute bridges

K.method: full 16020-state retrograde graph versus immediate-capture characterization on all 8010 initial positions

M.method: enumerate all polygon vertex subsets; verify both convolution indices with exact naive multiplication, not NTT
